Demisexuality could be described as a subpart of asexuality, as they go hand in hand. a demisexual, like asexuals, will not feel sexual attraction, at least not in the same way the commoner would. Instead of being directly attracted to a certain sex, they are attracted to the person as a whole. It is important to take note that there are various different amorous paths for demisexuals, as one could be demisexual and have only heterosexual interests for example. This would be known as being heteroromantic, and other subdivisions such as being homoromantic, biromantic, and panromantic exist with this first classification.
